tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅: thugs rje chen po 'gro 'dul las: tshe sgrub chen mo bzhugs so:

¿ thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo: thugs rje chen po tshe dpag med: rdo rje rin chen tshe sgrub ni: dus min 'chi las bzlog pa dang : tshe dbugs nyams dang zad pa bsring : bkra shis tshe yi sgrub pa bstan: dkyil 'khor rdzas dang ting 'dzin dang : sngags dang lha tshogs bskul ba dang : tshe dbang bskur cing bstim brtan dang : bkra shis brjod dang smon lam mo: dang po dkyil 'khor bstan pa ni: 'gro ba 'dul ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs: yang na maṇ+ḍal gtsang ma'i steng : 'bru brdal pad+ma 'dab drug bya: rdzas ni tshe yi bum pa ni: phyi yi bum pa rin po che: ma gas ma chag gtsang mar bya: nang ni mtshan ldan ka pā lar: 'bru mchog bcud ldan ma nyams blugs: nas 'bras phye ma mar gyis sbru: spod sna tshogs pas bran pa yi: tshe yi 'brang rgyas bcas nas ni: ril bu mched kyi grangs dang sbyar: sman dang bdud rtsi tshe chang blugs: gser g.yu gnyis kyi tshe rten bya: tshe bum dkyil 'khor dbus su bzhag: bar gcod bgegs bskrad gu gul bdug: thugs rje chen po'i da la yi: dam tshig sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed: ye shes dkyil 'khor dgug gzhug bya: tshe bum gzhal yas khang nang du: lha ni mgon po tshe dpag med: sku mdog dmar ser 'od dang ldan: zhal gcig phyag gnyis tshe bum bsnams: yum yang mā ma kī la 'khyud: rigs bzhi yab yum 'khor gyis bskor: sku mdog phyag mtshan rigs kyis ston: g.yas pa rigs kyi phyag mtshan la: g.yon pa tshe yi bum pa 'dzin: bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyis bskor: tshe bum nang du gsal bar bskyed: sngags kyi spro bsdu bya ba ni: tshe bum mgul nas gzungs thag gdag: bdag nyid dkyil 'khor lhar gsal la: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐: yi ge bcu pa'i bsnyen pa bya: stong rdzogs tshe yi bsnyen pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥbh+rūm̐ badz+ra ā yu she āḥ sid+dhi sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes ni brjod pa'i 'phro 'du yis:

thugs ka'i sngags phreng 'phros 'dus pas: bum pa'i lha tshogs rnams la thim: bum pa'i lha las 'od 'phros pas: lha dang drang srong rnams la phog: mchod mnyes byas nas tshe lha'i bcud: dngos grub tshul du bdag dang ni: bum pa'i lha yi thugs kar thim: rigs lnga bde bar gshegs pa yi: thugs nas 'od kyi bcud blangs nas: tshe yi bum pa'i nang du thim: yang ni sngags kyi spro bsdu yis: bum pa'i lha yi thugs ka nas: bdag dang bsgrub bya'i thugs kar thim: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub bsdus: rgyas btab snying gi nang na gnas: ha ya grī bas sgo bsrungs bsam: de nas tshe yi lha tshogs bskul: stong gsum lo ka'i khams kun nas: tshe nyams pa dang tshe zad pa: lha srin lag tu tshe shor ba: 'phrog dang bkug nas bdag la bstims: de nas yum lngas bstims la sba: de nas tshe yi dbang bskur la: bkra shis brjod de dbang bskur la: tshe yi 'brang rgyas tshe ril dang : tshe chang la sogs dngos grub blang : tshe yi dngos grub thob par 'gyur: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub thob: tshe sgrub chen po 'di brtsams pas: 'gro kun tshe ring grub thob shog: thugs rje chen po'i tshe sgrub chen mo rdzogs so: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gtad rgya: rgya rgya rgya: : ¿ thugs rje chen po la na mo: thugs rje chen po'i rin po che'i tshe sgrub 'di la don rnam pa dgu ste: dkyil 'khor bri ba dang : rdzas bsham pa dang : tshe'i ting nge 'dzin dang : sngags kyi spro bsdu bya ba dang : lha tshogs bskul tshe dgug pa dang : tshe dbang bskur ba dang : tshe bstim zhing brtan pa dang : bkra shis brjod pa dang : smon lam gdab pa'o: dang po da la bri ba ni: tshe sgrub gzhung 'dzugs na: thugs rje chen po 'gro ba 'dul ba'i da la bzhengs: glo bur du tshe chog byed na/ maṇ+ḍal steng du nas brdal: pad+ma 'dab ma drug pa byas la: de'i dbus su tshe bcas la bzhag go:

gnyis pa rdzas bsham pa ni: tshe chog gzhan don byed na: zangs la sogs pa rin po che'i bum pa'am rdza'am shing gi bum pa la bya'o: ma gas ma chag pa la: dag par bkrus la: mgul chings legs par bcing bar bya'o: nang ltar tshe'i sgrub pa byed na: tshe bum thod pa mtshan dang ldan pa la bya'o: bum pa'i nang du tshe chang zh-im la ma nyams pa ma 'bags pa gtsang mas dgang ngo : phyi'i tshe chog la: ka ra bu ram sbrang rtsi: lan tshwa mar rnams blug: nang gi tshe sgrub byed na bdud rtsi sman sgrub sman blug: bla g.yu kha dog legs pa dang : tshe rten gser gyi sbrang bu gzhug: tshe'i 'brang rgyas nas dang 'bras dang gro'i phye ma: sga dang go snyod lan tshwa sbrang rtsi bu ram dang ka ra btab la mar khus sbrus la tshe'i 'brang rgyas bcas la: tshe bum kha bcad: rta mgrin dang bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags kyis bgegs bskrad: gu gul gyi dud pas bdug: oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta ha ya gh+rī ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: ces tshe srog la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs bskrad do: tshe bum dkyil 'khor dbus su bzhag go: gsum pa tshe sgrub pa'i ting nge 'dzin: thugs rje chen po'i phrin las gzhung bsrangs la: dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor bskyed: ye shes 'di la spyan drangs: mchod bstod la sogs pa tshang bar bya'o: de nas tshe bum gyi nang du bh+rūm̐ las gzhal yas khang bsgom: pad+ma 'dab bzhi pa khyams dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor bsgom mo: dbus su tshe dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: phyag gnyis yum la 'khyud nas tshe'i bum pa 'dzin pa: yum mā ma kī sku mdog dmar po tshe'i bum pa bsnams nas yab la 'khyud pa: yab yum mnyam pa'i skyil krung du bzhugs nas: snyoms 'jug mdzad pas byang chub sems dkar dmar tshe bum gzhal yas khang du khengs par bsgom mo: phyogs bzhi'i pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi la: shar du rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum mthing : lhor rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum ser:

nub tu thugs rje chen po yab yum dmar: byang du don yod grub pa yab yum ljang : g.yas rdo rje dang : rin po che dang : pad+ma dang : rgya gram dang : so so'i rigs kyi phyag mtshan la: g.yon thams cad tshe'i bum pa 'dzin pa: yab yum mnyam pa'i skyil krung du bzhugs nas: snyoms 'jug mdzad nas byang sems tshe'i bdud rtsir 'khyil bar bsam mo: 'khor tshe'i lha mo brgyad kyis tshe 'gugs shing : bgegs kyi lag nas tshe 'phrog par bsgoms la: tshe bum gyi dal lha tshogs su gsal bar bsgom mo: bzhi pa tshe sgrub pa'i sngags kyis spro bsdu bya ba ni: tshe'i bum pa'i mgul nas shing bal gsum sgril byas pa'i: gzungs thag gtsang ma dris bsangs ba btags la: sgrub pa po'i srin lag la btags: thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs gsal btabs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐: zhes bzlas pa stong thon pa dang : dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la mchod bstod bya: de ni bsnyen pa'o: de nas tshe sgrub ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐ trām̐ hṝḥhā: bh+rūm̐ badz+ra ā yu ṣe sid+dhi sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes bzlas pas/ bdag thugs rje chen po'i thugs ka'i sngags phreng gi 'od zer bum pa'i lha tshogs la 'phros: bum pa'i lha tshogs kyi thugs ka nas sngags kyi 'od zer khams gsum du 'phros te: 'dod khams gzugs khams gzugs med khams kyi lha la sogs pa'i tshe dang bkrag bsdus drang srong tshe'i rig 'dzin thob pa rnams la 'od zer gyis mchod: tshe dang dngos grub bcud bsdus la tshe bum du bstim mo: yang 'od zer 'og min gyi gnas su 'phros pas: rigs lnga yab yum gyi thugs kar bstim: sku gsung thugs mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul bas: thugs ka'i ye shes kyi bcud blangs nas: tshe'i bum pa rigs lnga'i thugs kar thim par bsam mo: yang sngags 'di bzlas so: ā+oṃ brūm̐ dz+nyā na badz+ra ā yu she hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes bzlas pas: bum pa'i lha'i thugs ka nas bdag dang yon bdag rnams kyi thugs kar thim pas:

'chi ba med pa tshe'i dngos grub thob: bdag gzhan gyi snying gi nang na tshe srog gi snying po nṛ ljang khu gcig yod pa la thim nas tshe srog bkrag dang mdangs rgyas te rgyas btab nas tshe srog sbas pa la: dpal rta mgrin sku tshon gang ba gcig gis: tsit+ta'i sgo bsrungs nas bgegs kyi tshe srog la bar du mi gcod par bsam mo: lnga pa tshe'i lha tshogs bskul ba ni: hūm̐: bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med: sku mdog dmar la 'od zer 'phro: phyag na tshe yi bum pa bsnams: yum ni mā ma kī dang sbyor: de'i yang gsang thugs kyi ga'u: snying po thugs kyi āḥyuḥ'adi: gnas par gyur pa'i 'gro drug la: mgon po tshe bzhag gnas yin pas: gang gi tshe de gnas par mdzod: ā+oṃ brūṃ badz+ra ā yu she āḥ shar gyi phyogs nas tshe dpag med: rdo rje sems dpa' tshe yi bdag: phyag na shel gyi bum pa bsnams: 'du 'bral med pa'i tshe khug la: 'gyur ba med pa'i tshe stsol cig: hūm̐ brūṃ sid+dhi badz+ra ā yu she hūm̐ dzaḥ lho yi phyogs nas tshe dpag med: rin chen 'byung ldan tshe yi bdag: phyag na gser gyi bum pa bsnams: lhun gyis grub pa'i tshe khug la: 'dod pa yid bzhin tshe stsol cig: swā brūṃ sid+dhi rat+na ā yu she hūm̐ dzaḥ nub kyi phyogs nas tshe dpag med: 'jig rten mgon po tshe yi bdag: phyag na zangs kyi bum pa bsnams: rnam dag bdud rtsi'i tshe khug la: 'phel 'grib med pa'i tshe stsol cig: hrīḥbrūm̐ sid+dhi pad+ma ā yu she hūm̐ dzaḥ byang gi phyogs nas tshe dpag med: don yod grub pa tshe yi bdag: phyag na g.yu yi bum pa bsnams: 'pho 'gyur med pa'i tshe khug la: skye 'chi med pa'i tshe stsol cig: hāḥbrūm̐ sid+dhi karma ā yu she hūm̐ dzaḥ de nas rigs kyi yum bzhis tshe bstim zhing sba ba ni: shar gyi phyogs nas tshe 'dzin ma: rdo rje'i yum ste kun tu bzang : rin chen shel gyi bum pa bsnams:

tshe dang bdud rtsis bkang nas ni: rdo rje 'bar bas rgyas thob la: tshe 'di bcol lo srog 'di sdoms: hūm̐ āḥyuḥnṛ dzaḥ lho yi phyogs nas tshe 'dzin ma: rin chen yum ste gos dkar mo: rin chen gser gyi bum pa bsnams: tshe dang bdud rtsis bkang nas ni: rin chen 'bar bas rgyas thob la: tshe 'di bcol lo srog 'di sdoms: trām̐ ā yuḥnṛ dzaḥ nub kyi phyogs nas tshe 'dzin ma: pad+ma yum ste khro gnyer ma: pad+ma rā ga'i bum pa bsnams: tshe dang= pad+ma 'bar= tshe 'di= hrīḥ.ā yuḥnṛ dzaḥ byang gi phyogs nas tshe= las kyi yum ste dam tshig sgrol: phyag na g.yu yi bum pa bsnams: tshe dang bdud rtsis bkang nas ni: rgya gram 'bar bas rgyas thob la: tshe 'di bcol lo srog 'di sdoms: hā ā yuḥnṛ dza: ces pas yum bzhis tshe gnas su bstims nas rgyas btab par bsgom mo: de nas tshe'i pho nya lha mo brgyad kyis tshe dgug pa: shar phyogs gangs ri dkar po'i gzhal yas nas: dkar mo mgyogs ma tshe yi bum pa 'dzin: thugs kyi sprul pa lha mo dkar mo 'bum: rgyal po brgya byin lag nas tshe khug cig: nṛ brūṃ dzaḥdzaḥ lho phyogs baiḍūr+ya yi zhing khams nas: sngon mo mgyogs ma tshe yi= thugs kyi sprul pa lha mo sngon mo 'bum: gshin rje 'chi bdag lag nas tshe khug cig: nṛ brūṃ dzaḥdzaḥ nub phyogs pad+ma rā ga'i gzhal yas nas: dmar mo mgyogs ma tshe yi bum pa 'dzin: thugs kyi sprul pa dmar mo 'bum dang bcas: sa bdag klu gnyan lag nas tshe= nṛ brūṃ dzaḥdzaḥ byang phyogs in+d+ra nī la'i gzhal yas= ser ljang mgyogs ma tshe yi= thugs kyi sprul pa ser ljang 'bum dang bcas= bdud dang gnod sbyin lag nas tshe khug cig: nṛ brūṃ dzaḥdzaḥ yang phyag rgya bzhi'i lha mos tshe dgug pa/ khams gsum gnas nas tshe 'gug ma: lha mo rdo rje lcags kyu dkar: phyag na lcags kyu ga'u bsnams: drongs shig drongs shig tshe drongs shig: badz+ra aṃ ghu sha nṛ brūṃ dzaḥdzaḥ

dus gsum gnas nas tshe 'gugs ma: lha mo rdo rje zhags pa ser: phyag na zhags pa gwa'u bsnams: drongs shig drongs shig= badz+ra pā sha hūm̐ nṛ brūṃ dzaḥdzaḥ srid gsum gnas nas= lha mo rdo rje lcags sgrog dmar: phyag na lcags sgrog gwa'u bsnams: drongs shig= badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ nṛ brūṃ dzaḥdzaḥ mchod bstod gnas nas= lha mo rdo rje dril 'khrol sngo: phyag na dril bu ga'u bsnams: drongs shig drongs= badz+ra ghan+dhe ho nṛ brūṃ dzaḥdzaḥ mgyogs ma rnams kyis tshe drongs la: lha mo bzhi yis tshe stims la: 'chi med rdo rjes rgyas thob cig: byin chen rnams kyis byin phob la: dbang chen rnams kyis dbang skur cig: ā yu she dz+nyā na dzaḥdzaḥ zhes bskul bas: lha mo brgyad kyis tshe drangs te: tshe bstims nas: 'chi ba med pa'i tshe dang ldan par bsam mo: drug pa tshe dbang bskur ba ni: tshe bum btegs te sgrub pa po rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag la/ bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med: tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal bstod: sku gsung thugs ldan mkha' dang mnyam: tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal bstod: tshe yi dbang mchog bskur du gsol: oṃ bud+dha ka la sha a bhi ṣiñca oṃ: hūm̐ badz+ra ka la sha a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: trām̐ rat+na ka la sha a bhi ṣiñca trām̐: āṃ pad+ma ka la sha a bhi ṣiñca āḥ hā karma ka la sha a bhi ṣiñca hā: tshe'i dbang bskur bas: bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med pa'i sku tshe dang longs spyod dang ldan pa'i tshe'i dbang dang dngos grub thob par gyur cig: ces dbang bskur ro: bdun pa tshe bstim zhing brtan par bya ba ni: bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med: oṃ sku yi sku ste sku la thim: phung po lnga la rab tu thim: āḥgasung gi gsung ste gsung la thim: ljags kyi dbang po mchog la thim: hūm̐: thugs kyi thugs te thugs la thim: thugs kyi snying po tshe la thim: zhes lus ngag yid gsum la bstims nas brtan par bsam mo: brgyad pa bkra shis brjod cing dngos grub blangs:

bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med: 'chi ba med pa rdo rje'i tshe: spros pas khams gsum bkrag dang ldan: bsdus pas lus la gzi mdangs 'bar: bcings pas rdo rje lu gu rgyud: brtan pas mi 'gyur rdo rje 'dra: bdag cag skal ldan mched lcam la: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol: nyin mtshan gnyis kyi bkra shis pa: nyi zla bzhin du rgyun chad med: lo brgya 'tsho ba'i bkra shis pa: longs spyod ldan zhing phun sum tshogs: ston brgya mthong ba'i bkra shis pa: chos dang 'phrad nas sangs rgyas shog: dgu pa smon lam gdab pa/ tshe zan ye shes gsal bar gyur: tshe chang bdud rtsi byang sems gyur: tshe mar gsal stong thugs su gyur: sku gsum klong yangs tshe ru gyur: skye 'chi med pa'i tshe thob shog: 'gyur ba med pa'i sku thob shog: ces brjod la: tshe'i 'brang rgyas dang tshe ril dngos grub yin pas: tshe bum gyi lha rnams 'od du zhu ba bstims la rol lo: slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i: thugs rje chen po'i tshe sgrub chen mo rdzogs so: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gtad rgya: o rgyan pad+ma/ mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal/ khri srong lde'u btsan/ mnga' bdag chen po/ 'gro ba'i mgon po/ sras blo ldan/ mnga' bdag bdud 'dul/ mdo sde seng ge /mnga' bdag pad+ma dngos grub/ de la bdag chos seng gis zhus pa lags so/ /rdo rje lta bu'i tshe thob shog /lho brag lcags phur du bdag chos seng gis smyu gu phog tshad byas nas bris//
